verdict.rationale: PagerDuty publishes official OpenAPI schemas for its public APIs in the PagerDuty/api-schema GitHub repo. The developer docs give a direct raw openapiv3.json URL for importing into tools like Postman, and an interactive OpenAPI-based reference covers the REST, Events, SCIM, and integration APIs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the downloaded spec is complete and accurate.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Use [this URL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PagerDuty/api-schema/main/reference/REST/openapiv3.json) in the OpenAPI import tool to integrate Postman with OpenAPI
This repository contains our OpenAPI defined public APIs.
Interactive OpenAPI reference for the PagerDuty REST API, Events API, SCIM, MCP server, and integration APIs.
